findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, each party's total liability in respect of damages under this Agreement, any regulation or common law shall be limited to the sum of all amounts received from Client in terms of this Agreement; provided, however, that this limitation shall not apply with respect to any claims arising out of or relating to clause 6 (Inventions and Proprietary Information), indemnification obligations or damages arising from a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

6.1 CRO agrees that during the term of this Agreement and for a period of three years thereafter: (a) to disclose and assign to Client as its exclusive property all inventions and technical or business innovations specifically derived from the work assigned by Client to CRO which CRO develops or conceives, solely or in conjunction with others (1) that are based on or involve information of Client, (2) that relate to, constitute, result from, or include the work in which CRO will be engaged for Client, or (3) that are otherwise made through the use of any time, facilities or materials of Client;

(b) that all deliverables and work products in the form of works of authorship developed by CRO in the performance of Services under this Agreement shall be deemed works made for hire, and shall belong fully and exclusively to Client; and that if by operation of law such deliverables or work products are not works made for hire, CRO agrees to, and does hereby, assign to Client all right, title, and interest in such deliverables or work product, including all copyrights therein;

In the event that CRO believes that there is presently any such conflict, or any such conflict arises during the term of this Agreement, CRO will immediately notify Client which may, at its sole discretion, immediately terminate this Agreement without liability to CRO.

Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, each party's total liability in respect of damages under this Agreement, any regulation or common law shall be limited to the sum of all amounts received from Client in terms of this Agreement; provided, however, that this limitation shall not apply with respect to any claims arising out of or relating to clause 6 (Inventions and Proprietary Information), indemnification obligations or damages arising from a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
findings.explanation: Although there is a liability cap, your indemnification obligations and intellectual property claims are excluded from it, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial risk for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, each party's total liability in respect of damages under this Agreement shall be limited to the sum of all amounts received by the Contractor in terms of this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: 6.1 [PARTY_A] agrees that during the term of this Agreement and for a period of three years thereafter: (a) to disclose and assign to Client as its exclusive property all inventions and technical or business innovations specifically derived from the work assigned by Client to [PARTY_A] which [PARTY_A] develops or conceives, solely or in conjunction with others (1) that are based on or involve information of Client, (2) that relate to, constitute, result from, or include the work in which [PARTY_A] will be engaged for Client, or (3) that are otherwise made through the use of any time, facilities or materials of Client;
findings.explanation: Intellectual property is assigned to the Client upon creation or development without being explicitly conditioned on full payment, meaning the Client could own the work before you are paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services, the Contractor agrees to disclose and assign to the Client as its exclusive property all inventions and technical or business innovations specifically derived from the work assigned by the Client.

findings.quoted_text: (b) that all deliverables and work products in the form of works of authorship developed by [PARTY_A] in the performance of Services under this Agreement shall be deemed works made for hire, and shall belong fully and exclusively to Client; and that if by operation of law such deliverables or work products are not works made for hire, [PARTY_A] agrees to, and does hereby, assign to Client all right, title, and interest in such deliverables or work product, including all copyrights therein;
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation or delivery, rather than upon full payment, which puts you at risk if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Intellectual property rights in the deliverables shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such deliverables by the Contractor.

findings.quoted_text: In the event that [PARTY_A] believes that there is presently any such conflict, or any such conflict arises during the term of this Agreement, [PARTY_A] will immediately notify Client which may, at its sole discretion, immediately terminate this Agreement without liability to [PARTY_A].
findings.explanation: The client can terminate the agreement immediately without liability if a conflict of interest arises, leaving you without compensation for work already performed.
findings.suggested_change: In the event that the Contractor notifies the Client of a conflict of interest, the Client may terminate this Agreement upon written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all services rendered up to the date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the document and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, the current wording excludes indemnification and intellectual property claims from the liability cap; I propose limiting the total liability for both parties to the amounts received under the agreement. - Regarding the first intellectual property clause, ownership is assigned without being conditioned on full payment; I propose making the assignment conditional upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services. - Regarding the second intellectual property clause, rights transfer immediately upon creation; I propose that rights in the deliverables transfer only upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the termination clause upon a conflict of interest, the current text allows termination without liability; I propose ensuring that I am paid for all services rendered up to the date of termination. Please let me know if these updates work for you so we can proceed. Best regards,
